description: Pedestrian Classified by Seriousness of Injury and Sex is a dataset listed in Bahrain open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a national body, published or maintained by Ministry of Interior / General Directorate of Traffic. The injuries that result due to the occurrence of traffic accidents caused by pedestrians. Injuries are classified into three types: serious or simple injuries, or Fatalities. Coverage: Bahrain. The portal files it under Transportation. Its keywords are Transportation. The portal shows 48 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2026-04-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-data-gov-bh-portal.
